title: The nine-triangle diagram in a triangulated category
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof applies the octahedral axiom three times to construct all rows and columns. It then checks the factorization identities controlling the central squares and the required anticommutativity at the lower-right corner. This is a substantial sign-sensitive existence theorem from the abstract triangulated axioms.
